name: Two Knights Defense — Fried Liver Attack
description: White sacrifices the knight on f7 with 6.Nxf7, forcing Black's king into the center. Black must navigate with the king exposed while White launches an all-out attack on e6.

lines.name: Fried Liver Attack
lines.description: After 4.Ng5 d5 5.exd5 Nxd5 6.Nxf7, White sacrifices the knight to drag Black's king to f7. Black's critical defense is 8...Nb4!, attacking c2 and preparing counterplay. White ignores it with 9.O-O, Black steadies with 9...c6, and White blasts the center with 10.d4 — the king on e6 is caught in the crossfire.
